# Time on market decides your margin, not the staging price.

> Free calculator for independent home stagers: price a vacant-listing staging job from the included term, furniture carrying cost, crew labor, and mileage, then check whether your extension fee actually covers your own carrying cost before a slow listing erases the margin.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
